code_hints: On every navigation, try to accept cookies: click('#onetrust-accept-btn-handler') if present; fallback to button containing 'Accept All'.
If a geolocation/country modal appears, prefer an anchor/button that contains '/en-de/' or text 'Shop Germany'.
PLP load: wait for any of [data-component*='ProductGrid'] or a.cmp-producttile__image-link; then perform incremental scrolls (max 12) and also click a visible Load more button if present.
PLP extraction: collect unique hrefs from selectors in selectors.plp.product_card that end with .html and include '/en-de/'.
PDP extraction: first parse JSON-LD Product in script[type='application/ld+json'] for offers.price and name; fallback to selectors.pdp.price/title.
Use Accept-Language header 'en-DE,en;q=0.9' and a desktop UA to reduce locale prompts.
Guard against redirects: if location.pathname does not start with '/en-de/', rewrite URL to normalized '/en-de/' form and retry once.
rationale: The PLP likely failed due to a cookie consent/geolocation modal blocking content, and because product tiles on Moncler are lazy-loaded. We add robust consent/geo closers, wait-for product grid, and infinite scroll support. For PDP, JSON-LD parsing makes price/title extraction resilient to UI changes. URL normalization keeps us on /en-de and avoids country selector traps and monclergroup.com diversions.
